description.en: The village project with Mr Tyson: the place by the beck where the water is fastest, a level footing of stone, the walls and the tall oak rafters, the roof covered in slate, the wheel with its spokes and the channel for the water, and the first oats ground for everyone's porridge.
description.sl: Vaški projekt z gospodom Tysonom: kraj ob potoku, kjer je voda najhitrejša, raven kamnit temelj, zidovi in visoki hrastovi špirovci, streha, pokrita s skrilavcem, kolo z naperami in žleb za vodo ter prvi oves, zmlet za kašo za vse.
description.it: Il progetto del paese con il signor Tyson: il posto sul ruscello dove l'acqua è più veloce, fondamenta di pietra in piano, i muri e le alte travi di quercia, il tetto coperto d'ardesia, la ruota con i suoi raggi e il canale per l'acqua, e la prima avena macinata per il porridge di tutti.
description.de: Das Dorfprojekt mit Mr Tyson: der Platz am Bach, wo das Wasser am schnellsten ist, ein ebenes Fundament aus Stein, die Mauern und die hohen Eichensparren, das mit Schiefer gedeckte Dach, das Rad mit seinen Speichen und die Rinne fürs Wasser, und der erste Hafer, gemahlen für den Porridge aller.

words.example_en: The water is fast by the big stone.
words.example_sl: Pri velikem kamnu je voda hitra.
words.example_it: Vicino al sasso grande l'acqua è veloce.
words.example_de: Beim großen Stein ist das Wasser schnell.
words.note: The opposite: slow. fast, faster, the fastest.
words.note_sl: Nasprotje: slow (počasen). fast, faster, the fastest.
words.note_it: Il contrario: slow (lento). fast, faster, the fastest.
words.note_de: Das Gegenteil: slow (langsam). fast, faster, the fastest.

words.example_en: This is a good place for the mill.
words.example_sl: To je dober kraj za mlin.
words.example_it: Questo è un buon posto per il mulino.
words.example_de: Das ist ein guter Platz für die Mühle.

words.example_en: The walls stand on a footing of stone.
words.example_it: I muri poggiano su fondamenta di pietra.
words.example_de: Die Mauern stehen auf einem Fundament aus Stein.
words.note: The stones at the bottom of a wall, in the ground: its foot. Builders also say the foundations.
words.note_sl: Kamni na dnu zidu, v zemlji: njegovo stopalo. Gradbeniki rečejo tudi foundations.
words.note_it: Le pietre alla base di un muro, nella terra: il suo piede. I costruttori dicono anche foundations.
words.note_de: Die Steine unten an einer Mauer, in der Erde: ihr Fuß. Bauleute sagen auch foundations.

words.example_it: Le fondamenta devono essere in piano.
words.note: Flat and straight, not leaning. A level is also the tool with a bubble that shows it.
words.note_sl: Plosk in raven, ne nagnjen. A level je tudi libela, orodje z mehurčkom.
words.note_it: Piatto e dritto, non storto. A level è anche la livella, l'attrezzo con la bolla.
words.note_de: Flach und gerade, nicht schief. A level ist auch die Wasserwaage mit der Blase.

words.example_en: The oak rafters hold the roof.
words.example_it: Le travi di quercia reggono il tetto.
words.note: One of the long sloping beams of a roof.
words.note_sl: Eden od dolgih poševnih tramov strehe.
words.note_it: Una delle lunghe travi inclinate del tetto.
words.note_de: Einer der langen schrägen Balken eines Dachs.

words.example_en: The mill is as tall as a tree.
words.example_it: Il mulino è alto come un albero.
words.example_de: Die Mühle ist so hoch wie ein Baum.
words.note: For people, trees and buildings: tall. For mountains: high. tall, taller, the tallest.
words.note_sl: Za ljudi, drevesa in stavbe: tall. Za gore: high. tall, taller, the tallest.
words.note_it: Per persone, alberi ed edifici: tall. Per le montagne: high. tall, taller, the tallest.
words.note_de: Für Menschen, Bäume und Gebäude: tall. Für Berge: high. tall, taller, the tallest.

words.example_en: We cover the roof with slates.
words.example_it: Copriamo il tetto con le lastre d'ardesia.
words.example_de: Wir decken das Dach mit Schieferplatten.
words.note: To put something over the top of something else. Also a noun: a cover.
words.note_sl: Dati nekaj čez nekaj drugega. Tudi samostalnik: a cover (pokrov, prevleka).
words.note_it: Mettere qualcosa sopra qualcos'altro. Anche nome: a cover (una copertura).
words.note_de: Etwas über etwas anderes legen. Auch ein Nomen: a cover (eine Abdeckung).

words.note: A stick from the middle of a wheel to its edge. A bicycle wheel has thin metal spokes.
words.note_sl: Palica od sredine kolesa do roba. Kolo bicikla ima tanke kovinske napere.
words.note_it: Un bastone dal centro della ruota al bordo. La ruota della bici ha raggi sottili di metallo.
words.note_de: Ein Stab von der Mitte eines Rads zum Rand. Ein Fahrradrad hat dünne Metallspeichen.

words.example_en: The water runs along the channel to the wheel.
words.example_sl: Voda teče po žlebu do kolesa.
words.example_it: L'acqua scorre nel canale fino alla ruota.
words.example_de: Das Wasser fließt durch die Rinne zum Rad.
words.note: A long narrow way for water. Also a TV channel.
words.note_sl: Dolga ozka pot za vodo. Tudi televizijski program (TV channel).
words.note_it: Una via lunga e stretta per l'acqua. Anche un canale televisivo.
words.note_de: Ein langer schmaler Weg für Wasser. Auch ein Fernsehsender (TV channel).

words.example_en: The mill grinds the oats into oatmeal.
words.example_it: Il mulino macina l'avena in farina.
words.example_de: Die Mühle mahlt den Hafer zu Mehl.
words.note: I grind, it grinds; yesterday it ground (not grinded).
words.note_sl: I grind, it grinds; yesterday it ground (ne grinded).
words.note_it: I grind, it grinds; yesterday it ground (non grinded).
words.note_de: I grind, it grinds; yesterday it ground (nicht grinded).

words.example_en: Everyone has a bowl of porridge.
words.example_it: Tutti hanno una ciotola di porridge.
words.note: All the people. It takes the verb for one: everyone is here, everyone has.
words.note_sl: Vsi ljudje. Ima glagol za enega: everyone is here, everyone has.
words.note_it: Tutte le persone. Vuole il verbo al singolare: everyone is here, everyone has.
words.note_de: Alle Leute. Es hat das Verb in der Einzahl: everyone is here, everyone has.
